title: Content gate enabled, exporter reads raw tool output
reason_not_testable: The assertion is about the OTEL exporter span event body (tool.output with OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT=1). The fixture format cannot set OTEL_* env for claude -p, cannot run a collector, and cannot observe exporter output. Only the Read tool_response is observable, and the rewrite of that is not what the case asserts. Non-hook control: managed settings pinning OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT off, plus collector-side scrubbing (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/monitoring-usage).
